speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing agitation and have noticed a yellowish tint to your skin and eyes; has this discoloration been present for days or weeks? Additionally, have you recently consumed large amounts of alcohol, acetaminophen, or any herbal supplements?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hepatitis A. The patient's young age, history of high-risk sexual behavior, acute onset of jaundice and agitation, and lack of significant alcohol or acetaminophen use strongly suggest an infectious etiology acquired via the fecal-oral route or sexual contact.
